title: SignalGraph artifact-versus-intentional latency semantics and the static realtime report

needles: Intentional 500 ms echo on a wet branch never delays the dry path
Graph realtime report measures counted work without allocating
Oversampling with a frequency-dependent delay cannot be declared as node latency

installed_sdk.rationale: CustomNodeType gains appended intentional-delay, per-output-port latency and declared realtime-contract members after every historical field, so positional aggregate initializers keep compiling and an unset member preserves prior behaviour. graph_rt_report.hpp is a new control-thread-only header under the installed host include root. custom_node_oversampling.hpp is a header-only helper that derives a node's declared latency and its oversampler setup from one spec and refuses filter kinds whose delay is not constant; it adds no member to CustomNodeType.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: pulp graph report prepares a saved graph with plugins unloaded and prints the realtime report; it never writes files and admits bounded sample-rate, block-size and measured-block options.

needles: pulp graph report prints the realtime report and refuses bad options

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: The read-only MCP projection of the report is recorded on the graph MCP command surface row; this row adds no further MCP surface.

live_product_control.rationale: Latency semantics are captured at prepare and the report is control-thread only; no live control, event edge or executor authority is added.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No agent capability entry changes; only reviewed header fingerprints were refreshed.
